uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Reduces the duration of debuffs inflicted on this Pokémon by 50%. Reduces the duration of debuff effects inflicted on Dragapult by 50%

Becomes boosted attacks when the boosted attack gauge is full, dealing increased damage in an area of effect centered on the opposing Pokémon they hit. Each time the user deals damage to opposing Pokémon, the boosted attack gauge increases by 1, becoming full when the user deals damage 8 times. After not dealing damage for 3s, the boosted attack gauge decreases by 2 every 0.5s. Each time damage is dealt to enemies, boosted basic attack gauge increases. When the boosted basic attack gauge is full (after 8 instances of damage), the Pokémon's basic attacks become boosted attacks.

Each time damage is dealt to enemies, boosted basic attack gauge increases. When the boosted basic attack gauge is full (after 8 instances of damage), the Pokémon's basic attacks become boosted attacks.

Lets out a sound blast in a forward direction. The shout explodes when it hits an enemy or after traveling a set distance, dealing damage in an area and decreasing enemy movement speed by 30% for 2s. Lets out a sound blast in a forward direction. The shout explodes when it hits an enemy or after traveling a set distance, dealing damage in the area and decreasing their movement speed for a short time

The user exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s. The gust leaves the ground burning for 3s, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s (up to 7 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s. If this move is used while the user is flying with Dragon Dance, the mighty gust is exhaled along Dragon Dance's flight path instead, with the same effects; the burning ground can hit up to 9 times. Exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed. The gust also leaves the ground burning for a set amount of time. Pokémon in this area of effect take damage over tim and have their movement speed decreased for a short time. If this move is used while the uesr is flying with Dragon Dance, the mighty gust is exhaled along Dragon Dance's flight path, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and the decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
Increases the damage of this move and the burning ground; strengthens the movement speed decrease to 45%. Deals increased damage and further decreases their movement speed

The user hurls a shadowy blob in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and applying a marker with 4 parts to them for 5s; then dashes in the chosen direction forward. When the user hits a marked target, one part of the marker is consumed to deal additional damage. The fourth part of the mark deals increased additional damage and removes the mark when consumed, and the user restores 20% max HP. Hurls a shadowy blob in the designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon it touches and applying a mark to them. When marked Pokémon are hit by Dragapult, they receive additional damage. The fourth time the marked Pokémon is hit, the mark is removed, but the damage dealt by the attack is further increased and the user recovers HP. After using this move, the user moves a short distance in a designated direction.
Increases the damage of this move and the additional damage from marks. Increased Damage
Dashes in the designated direction, increasing basic attack speed by 40% for 2s. Dashes in the designated direction, increasing its basic attack speed for a short time

The user prepares a circular flight path in the designated direction, then moves into a direction either side to fly on the path; the flight path takes 3.5s to complete. While flying, the user increases their basic attack speed by 200% and they continuously use auto attacks, dealing 10% reduced damage to opposing Pokémon hit. If this move is used again while the user is flying, the user stops flying, becomes briefly invincible and dashes a short distance forward. If the user knocks out a Pokémon from the opposing team, this move's cooldown is reset. If the user assists in knocking out a Pokémon from the opposing team instead, this move's cooldown is reduced by 50%. When this move is used, Dragon Breath's cooldown is reset. Flies in a circular pattern in the designated direction. While flying, it continuously deals damage to nearby enemies with basic attacks that deal less damage but have increased attack speed. If this move is used again while the user is flying, the user stops flying and moves a short distance in the designated direction. If the user knocks out an enemy, this move's cooldown is reset. If the user assists in a knock out, this move's cooldown is reduced by half. When this move is used, Dragon's Breath's cooldown is reset
While the user is flying, auto attacks restore the user's HP for an additional 25% of damage dealt. While the user is flying, its attacks also restores HP when they hit

The user enters stealth for up to 6s or until using an attack, increasing their movement speed by 30% and increasing the boosted basic attack gauge by 1 every 1s. When the user exits stealth, the user's basic attack speed is increased by 85% for 3s. When this move is learned, if the user knocks out a Pokémon from the opposing team, this move's cooldown is reset and the user's Attack is increased by 8 until the end of the battle (up to 10 times; maximum 80 bonus Attack). For a short time, increases the user's movement speed and enters stealth. While the user is in stealth, the boosted basic attakck gauge increases. When stealth ends, Dragapult's basic attack speed is increased for a short time. After this move is learned, if the user knocks out an enemy, this move's cooldown is reset and Dragapult's Attack is increased by 6 until the end of battle. This Attack increase can stack up to 8 times.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 0.5s per opposing Pokémon hit by the user's auto attacks. Reduces this move's cooldown by 0.5s when the user deals damage to enemies with basic attacks.

The user launches two Dreepy at up to 2 different opposing Pokémon in range, damaging them and dealing additional missing HP damage to each target. If there is only one target in range, the second Dreepy deals 30% of the full damage to the target. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this Unite Move; there is a 2s cooldown between uses for this move. Against wild Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 1200. Also deals 10% of enemy missing HP. 30% of Damage Launches two Dreepy and each deals damage to different Pokémon in the area of effect. The lower the opposing Pokémon's remaining HP is, the more damage the Dreepy deal. If there is only one target in the area of effect, both Dreepy target that Pokémon and deal damage to it. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move. Dreepy may be fired once every 2 seconds. Neither Cooldown Reduction nor gaining Aeos Energy reduce the cooldown of Dreep and Destroy.
Buffs: 10% Max HP Shield, 10% Movement Speed for 3s; Has an internal cooldown of 30s to activate Energy Amplifier; Has an internal cooldown of 60s to activate Buddy Barrier; Buff duration: 3

source.name: Dreep and Destroy
source.originalDescription: The user launches two Dreepy at up to 2 different opposing Pokémon in range, damaging them and dealing additional missing HP damage to each target. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this Unite Move; there is a 2s cooldown between uses for this move. Against wild Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 1200. Also deals 10% of enemy missing HP. 30% of Damage Launches two Dreepy and each deals damage to different Pokémon in the area of effect. The lower the opposing Pokémon's remaining HP is, the more damage the Dreepy deal. If there is only one target in the area of effect, both Dreepy target that Pokémon and deal damage to it. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move. Dreepy may be fired once every 2 seconds. Neither Cooldown Reduction nor gaining Aeos Energy reduce the cooldown of Dreep and Destroy.
